description: This file contains server-side code for the Admin Panel page of an online examination system. It defines event handlers for various buttons that navigate to different pages such as Admin Queue, Leaderboard, Set Exam, Edit Exam, and Login.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Admin Panel page, handling button click events to navigate among pages.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event of the page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button, currently empty.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the SetExam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the EditExam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the LoginPage for user logout.
